plugins.name: DubThrow
plugins.description: Dub-desk send throw on the XY pad. Dry always passes; pad throw feeds a BPM-synced stereo delay with feedback-path bandpass. X = throw amount, Y = feedback tone. Release stops new input while the echo tail decays.

params.name: THROW
params.detail: Send / throw amount (left = nearly dry, right = full throw)

params.name: TONE
params.detail: Feedback bandpass cutoff (down = dark tail, up = bright / nasal)

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: Overall wet ceiling and throw sensitivity

params.name: FDBK
params.detail: Base feedback ceiling (high for near self-oscillation)

params.name: SPRD
params.detail: L/R delay time spread (dub stereo offset)

params.name: TOUCH
params.detail: Gate (hold to throw), Latch (keep send), Always (X only)

plugins.name: GlitchPad
plugins.description: Glitch²-style XY pad for NTS-3. Keeps a tempo-synced AUDIO IN buffer (get_raw_input on firmware 1.4+) and locks one of four scenes from the touch start region, like Passort. Top-left = Retrigger. Top-right = Reverse. Bottom-left = Shuffle. Bottom-right = Gate. While held, Y sets slice / rate (bottom = long, top = short). Depth = wet. Untouched = bypass. DECAY fades repeats / gate edges. SYNC: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE. HOLD: GATE or LATCH.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the effect is engaged

params.name: DECAY
params.detail: Retrigger fade, shuffle fade, and gate edge smoothing

params.name: SYNC
params.detail: Time grid: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to glitch. LATCH = stays after release; switch back to GATE to stop

plugins.name: StepFlanger
plugins.description: Tempo-synced sample-and-hold flanger on AUDIO IN. Y is dual around center: distance sets LFO depth, sign sets feedback polarity (up = +, down = −). STEPS redraws random feedback amount; LFO is a separate tempo-synced sweep cycle. X = base delay. Hold the pad to engage; release returns to dry.

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: Bipolar around center: |Y| = LFO depth, sign(Y) × step-random = feedback (+ up / − down)

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the pad is held

params.name: SLEW
params.detail: How quickly feedback glides to each new random value

plugins.name: StepGateDelay
plugins.description: Euclidean 1/16 gate into a tempo delay. Hold the pad to engage; the nearest 16th clock becomes relative step 0 (Ride909-style). X = Euclidean density among 16 steps (hits open the gate). Y = delay wet. SHAPE picks the per-step envelope: SQR, decaying SAW, RAMP, TRI, or EXP. Default delay is a dotted eighth. Feedback has high/low damp; low damp is on by default so repeats stay thin.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Overall wet while the pad is held

params.name: SHAPE
params.detail: Gate envelope: SQR, SAW (decay), RAMP, TRI, EXP

plugins.name: StoneRes
plugins.description:
Rub the XY pad to grind a stone surface; a chord resonator bank remaps the friction noise. LOAD/ROUGH on the pad, MAT/GRAIN/DAMP for the stone, ROOT/CHORD for the resonator.
Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Stone dry vs chord resonator wet
